about: 10CL016 routing switch (PIP) bits, translation-pooled (routemap.py pooled) from 900 two-LE builds labelled with quartus_sta report_timing -show_routing (routes.py). Key: (from type, from index I, from x - to x, from y - to y, to type, to index I). Value: [instances, [[frame offset, row-space offset], ...], anchor] where anchor 'to' or 'from' says which end's (x, y) the bits are relative to: frame = LUT frame 0 of LE N0 in column x (lutpos) + offset; row-space index = lutpos.ROW[y] low byte + PLANE_START[plane] + offset. Keys with 1-4 candidate bits only. 5-fold cross-validation (anchor chosen on the training folds): ~760 keys per fold; all predicted bits present in 98.73% of held-out uses (13255/13426), absent in 99.64% of held-out non-uses (657699/660073). Offline; I/O (periphery) PIPs, M9K/DSP-column anchors and bundles of more than 4 bits are not covered.
